title: Concept: Legacy TLS protocol enabled in the server configuration in nginx — review required
description: In nginx, the TLS listener advertises protocol versions that are deprecated or broken. Allowing them lets a downgrade-capable attacker negotiate a version with weaker record protection and cipher suites, and it fails baseline scans even when clients would have used TLS 1.3. The directive is usually inherited from an old template.
applicability: nginx web servers that terminate TLS.
risk: Protocol downgrade and weak record protection; MEDIUM severity.
